text: Geethanjali College of Engineering and Technology (GCET) is part of the Geethanjali Group of Institutions, run by Teja Educational Society. Tagline: 'Epicenter for Transformation'; motto: 'Striving towards perfection'. The college offers Engineering and Pharmacy streams. It has achieved close to 100% admissions since 2005. The main web presence is gcet.edu.in (the geethanjaliinstitutions.com homepage is a splash page linking to it).

GCET campus address: Sy. No. 33 & 34, Cheeryala (V), Keesara (M), Medchal District, Telangana, PIN 501301. The managing Teja Educational Society is registered at Bandlaguda, Nagole, Hyderabad, Telangana, PIN 500068.

GCET is approved by AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education), New Delhi. It holds NAAC accreditation (2022) and NBA accreditation (2025). The site also references NIRF 2026 documents. University affiliation is not stated on the About page.
Vision of GCET: 'To be an epicenter, promoting scholarly activities, fostering innovation, research, and entrepreneurship, leading sustainable societal development.'

Mission of GCET: (1) To solve complex societal problems, inculcating critical thinking and problem-solving skills. (2) To inculcate creativity and innovation, developing a culture of research and entrepreneurship. (3) To preserve and promote cultural heritage, humanistic and spiritual values, promoting peace and harmony in society.

GCET B.Tech (undergraduate) programs and annual intake: Civil Engineering (30); Computer Science and Engineering (540, +60 additional AICTE-approved); CSE - Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (300, +60); CSE - Cyber Security (180); CSE - Data Science (180); Electrical and Electronics Engineering (60); Electronics and Communication Engineering (120); Electronics Engineering - VLSI Design and Technology (60); Mechanical Engineering (30). Total UG intake 1440 (+180 additional). Freshman Engineering is listed without a separate intake.
GCET postgraduate programs and annual intake: M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (18); MBA (60). Total PG intake 78.

GCET departments are organized into schools: School of Computer Science & Informatics (CSE, CSE-AI&ML, CSE-Cyber Security, CSE-Data Science, CSE-IoT); School of Electrical & Communication Engineering (EEE, ECE); plus Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Freshman Engineering, and Management Studies (MBA). ECE maintains its own separate website.

GCET placement highlights: For the 2026 graduating batch, the highest package is 51 LPA (ServiceNow, offered to Challa Saraswathi Lalith, CSE). For the 2025 graduated batch, the highest package is 41 LPA (Autodesk, offered to Ram Charan Lellapalli, IoT). The 2025 batch recorded a total of 1433 offers.

GCET recruiting companies include Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, IBM, HCL, Tech Mahindra, Accenture, Virtusa, NTT Data, EPAM, Dell, Byjus, Kia Motors, Amazon, and Sutherland. Students have also been selected by ISRO / Vikram Sarabhai Space Research Centre. The 2026 batch summary listed 94 recruiting companies; the 2025 batch listed 100. Average package and overall placement percentage are not published on the site.

The GCET Training & Placement Cell forges linkages with industry, liaises with companies and associations to facilitate training, live projects and placement assistance, and organizes guest lectures and seminars.
